description: A Laravel-inspired toolkit for .NET, bringing expressive APIs, developer-friendly abstractions, and elegant patterns to the C# ecosystem.
ASP.NET Core integration for Laranet.Data pagination responses.
Command-line tool for generating Laranet application code.
Provider-neutral IQueryable search, sorting, and pagination utilities for Laranet.

This Cache project includes some cache classes, help classes, etc.

Sends errors, logs, metrics and traces from .NET apps to a self-hosted Atalog installation: bounded queues, batched delivery, sensitive data scrubbing, ASP.NET Core middleware and ILogger provider. It never crashes your app.

trax-console, the Trax .NET operations console in a terminal: runs, dead letters, the work queue, manifests, a run's trace and machine instances, read and acted on over a host's Trax GraphQL operations surface with the same documents the browser console sends. Also answers in JSON lines for scripts…

Drive a Trax state machine a host serves from .NET: Blazor, MAUI, Avalonia, WPF or another service. Send a Trax host's persisted GraphQL documents from .NET: a document by the id the host registered it under, or as text when the host runs it unregistered, over HTTP POST, and its streams over one graphql-transport-ws socket that subscribes again when it reconnects. Derive Trax .NET state machines from Gherkin features and a glossary: each machine's portable IR and the host file that says who may use it, checked by replaying every scenario on what was derived.

Reqnroll bindings that run Trax .NET features against a host in the test process: one binding for every step the glossary reads, each person a user of their own, Givens arranged through the host's store and everything else sent over GraphQL as a client sends it.
